title: Who Approved This? Coding Agents, Human Accounts, and Merge-Gate Evidence at a Fintech Startup
abstract: arXiv:2610.28683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: From 3 October, every non-bot merge into our main branch passed a non-author review gate, yet 71 of those 263 merges (27%) rested only on an approval that a coding agent had submitted through the technical lead's GitHub account, and the platform recorded each one as an ordinary approval by the lead. We report twelve weeks of agent-driven development at Bashi AI, a fintech startup preparing for a SOC 2 audit: 786 merged pull requests, 657 of them associated with agents by explicit markers or by inference, analysed from platform records and saved agent-session transcripts. In the gated phase, an agent session submitted every approval the lead's account gave on a colleague's pull request, and issued nearly all of its merges; the records cannot show who decided any of them. We recompute, for every merge, a core gate property: a non-author approval and a passing required check, both before the merge and both on the exact revision merged. The

translated_title: 谁批准的？一家金融科技初创公司中的编码智能体、人类账号与合并门禁证据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28683v1 公告类型：新。摘要：自10月3日起，每一个非机器人合并进入我们的主分支都必须通过一个非作者评审门禁，然而263次合并中有71次（27%）仅依赖于一个由编码智能体通过技术负责人的GitHub账号提交的批准，并且平台将其中每一次都记录为该负责人的普通批准。我们报告了在Bashi AI（一家正在准备SOC 2审计的金融科技初创公司）进行的为期十二周的智能体驱动开发：共786个已合并的拉取请求，其中657个通过显式标记或推断被关联到智能体，分析基于平台记录和保存下来的智能体会话转录。在启用门禁的阶段，负责人账号在同事的拉取请求上给出的每一次批准都是由智能体会话提交的，并且它发起了几乎所有的合并；记录无法显示其中任何一次是由谁决定的。我们为每一次合并重新计算了一个核心门禁属性：存在非作者批准且必需检查通过，两者都发生在合并之前，且都针对被合并的确切修订版本。
tldr: 该论文通过分析一家金融科技初创公司十二周内786次合并请求的审计数据，揭示尽管设有非作者评审门禁，仍有27%的合并仅依赖编码智能体冒用技术负责人账号提交的批准，且平台记录无法证明任何合并的实际决策者，暴露了智能体时代合并门禁审计证据的失效。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 786 merged pull requests over twelve weeks of agent-driven development at a fintech startup, this paper shows that despite a non-author review gate, 27% of merges rested solely on approvals submitted by a coding agent through the technical lead's GitHub account, and platform records cannot prove who actually decided any merge, exposing a breakdown of merge-gate audit evidence.
